label: Compare
seo_title: RunMyCampus Compare - Evaluate school management alternatives
seo_description: Compare tenant architecture, admin controls, and parent/teacher experience before choosing your platform.
headline: Compare on architecture, not just feature count.
subheadline: Use objective criteria to evaluate tenancy, security, workflow depth, and long-term operational fit.

segments.title: Tenant isolation
segments.body: Each school can run on dedicated domain, controls, and policy boundaries.

segments.title: Operational depth
segments.body: Finance, academics, support, and compliance are first-class modules, not bolt-ons.

segments.title: Governance and scale
segments.body: Manager command center and registry-driven defaults scale without per-tenant code.

metrics.label: canonical host contract
metrics.detail: Public, tenant, manager, API, and docs surfaces are explicitly separated.

metrics.label: subdomain tenancy
metrics.detail: No path-based tenant rendering in production contract.

metrics.label: governance layers
metrics.detail: School-level control, manager oversight, and registry-based defaults.

metrics.label: operator traceability
metrics.detail: Support and provisioning actions remain attributable and reviewable.

execution_blocks.title: Architecture fit assessment
execution_blocks.body: Map your current operating model to strict host, tenancy, and governance requirements.

execution_blocks.title: Migration risk reduction
execution_blocks.body: Stage rollout with redirect compatibility and operational smoke checks before cutover.

execution_blocks.title: Support readiness validation
execution_blocks.body: Confirm manager workflow coverage for provisioning, escalation, and impersonation audit trails.

comparison_rows.runmycampus: Strict subdomain tenancy, isolated auth and data context.
comparison_rows.legacy: Path-based tenancy increases cross-tenant risk and routing complexity.

comparison_rows.runmycampus: Dedicated manager host for support, approvals, and health visibility.
comparison_rows.legacy: Mixed admin routes on public host dilute control boundaries.

comparison_rows.runmycampus: Registry-driven hydration for terminology and compliance defaults.
comparison_rows.legacy: Country-specific forks and hardcoded strings create maintenance debt.

comparison_rows.runmycampus: Plan-based scale from single campus to white-label enterprise.
comparison_rows.legacy: Feature sprawl without operational stage alignment.

migration_narrative: Assess your current stack against host, tenancy, and governance criteria above.
Plan data migration and redirect strategy with dry-run and parity checks before cutover.
Use RunMyCampus migration tools and templates to move students, staff, and historical data.
Go live with phased rollout and dedicated support; validate with smoke tests and rollback readiness.
